title: New extremal Kähler metrics on projective bundles
summary: Consider a holomorphic vector bundle $E$ over a compact complex curve $C$ which decomposes as a sum of stable vector bundles. For the projectivization $\mathbb{P}(E)$, we prove that the existence of a compatible extremal almost Kähler (aK) metric of involutive type in the sense of Lejmi is equivalent to the existence of a Calabi extremal Kähler metric. This result rests on the Yau--Tian--Donaldson correspondence in terms of the moment polytope $Δ$ for $\mathbb{P}(E)$, proved by the author and Yin in a previous work.
